_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Full reference: README.md#configuration
_port: Dashboard port. It always listens on 127.0.0.1 only; reach it from elsewhere with an ssh tunnel.
_stats_interval: Seconds between system stats samples (CPU, RAM, disks, services).
_ping_targets: Pinged from every host. "gateway" means each host's own default gateway.
_labels: Optional display names for plain ping targets. Hosts below are labelled by their ip automatically.
_hosts: name: unique id. label: display name. ip: LAN address (labels pings and connections to it). ssh: ssh destination or ~/.ssh/config alias; omit to run on this machine. extra_targets: more ping targets for this host only. stats: omit to skip system stats; mounts, services (systemd units) and pm2 (true lists the ssh user's pm2 apps) are read by the agent over ssh, or set url to poll a sysstats.py HTTP agent instead.
_watchdog: Optional. Remove to disable. Listener for POST /api/watchdog. bind: LAN address to listen on. port: default 8766. allow: client IPs allowed to push. token_file: file holding the Bearer token (32+ chars), relative to this config file.
